title: Authored envelope density and structure threshold assay
campaignQuestion: Where does FLUX preservation of an authored bauplan change nonlinearly as representation density and anatomical organization are independently degraded?
firstInformativeResult: Five camera-identical density cells at one short prompt and one fixed seed.

cells.role: transition where density loss begins to damage structure

structureAxis.historicalRevisionDisposition: Provenance only. The revisions are not visibly monotonic enough to claim a controlled quality ladder.

prompt.role: short deformable-surface elaboration probe with prior successful morphology registration

interpretation.primaryRead: Compare survival of cranial direction, neck-to-scapula transition, trunk proportions, pelvic mass, rear limb chain, feet, and tail root against the matched source cell.
interpretation.nonlinearSignal: A sharp preservation change between adjacent density cells, rather than a smooth loss of incidental detail.
interpretation.claimCeiling: This pass can locate a candidate density threshold for one prompt, seed, route, camera, and authored envelope. It cannot establish a universal polygon threshold or separate density from structure in r030 and r015.
interpretation.nextPredicate: Run the fixed-density structure axis next. Cross one structure variant with r050 only if both independent axes produce distinguishable effects.
